provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study, not new experimental measurements.
provenance.scope: Results are conditional on the complete stated model, measurement convention and units.

model: One ideal dilute NONIONIC solute at fixed T obeys gamma(c)=gamma0-R*T*Gamma_inf*ln(1+K*c) with unknown common positive Gamma_inf. Fit all concentration/tension observations with equal unweighted tension residuals, keeping gamma0 and K fixed at their independent values. Gibbs surface excess is Gamma(c)=-(1/(R*T))*d gamma/d ln(c), using gamma in N/m.
interpretation: Under the declared single-layer molecule-count convention area per adsorbed molecule is1/(N_A*Gamma). Report that area in nm^2. The specified base-10 error uses -(1/(R*T))*d gamma/d log10(c) without the necessary base conversion; report erroneous/correct excess. Surface excess is an amount per area, not film thickness, and no density, molecular volume or layer geometry is supplied.
